periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downwards toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, creating a teardrop morphology with the bulk of the pigment below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shape profile at the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness across the transverse axis, occupying roughly one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap, roughly equivalent to the width of the cranial vault between the medial ear bases.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and rounded at the superior boundary.
